newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco H1 expatriate remittance $947 mln, up 2.7p. [Corrected 14:05 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Morocco H1 expatriate remittance $947 mln, up 2.7p. [Corrected 14:05 gmt]

text.p: Moroccans living abroad remitted 8.02 billion dirhams ($947 million) in the first half of this year, an increase of 2.7 percent over the same period last year.

The Office des Changes, Morocco's trade regulatory body, said in its latest bulletin that remittances in the first half of 1996 rose 220 million dirhams from 8.02 billion (corrects from "1.28 billion").
Moroccans based in France contributed 63 percent of the remittances, followed by those in Benelux countries, 8.4 percent, Italy, Germany and the Netherlands.
Remittances from the Arab World were headed by those from the United Arab Emirates, 2.9 percent, and Saudi Arabia, 2.0 percent. ($1= 8.7 dirhams)
